isolation_requirement: Staging key must be SEPARATE from any production key. Never use production DeepSeek API key for staging validation.
provisioning_steps: 1. Create DeepSeek account or access existing staging account
3. Set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_STAGING=sk-... in staging .env (NOT VITE_ prefix, backend-only)
4. Verify key does NOT equal any production key
5. Run Gate D test: settings.deepseek_api_key_staging is not None
6. Then proceed to P1.33.5 or real provider activation phase
gate_d_note: Credential not provisioned. Deferred to MVP-R1 or explicit authorization.
